name: motion-designer-studio
description: Codex-first AI motion design studio: Creative DNA, Style Lock, storyboard, renderer routing, code-native build, preview/review loops and multi-format delivery.

interface.longDescription: Motion Designer turns a brief or existing product repo into a production-ready motion project. It inspects the current codebase, builds Creative DNA and Style Lock, creates a timed storyboard, routes scenes to Remotion, HyperFrames/HTML+GSAP, Motion Canvas, Three.js or FFmpeg, then builds previews and runs a bounded visual review/fix loop. Generative video is treated as an optional shot-asset layer, not the master timeline. Studio defaults favor premium visual-first composition, minimal copy, purposeful motion and strong anti-AI-slop rules.
defaultPrompt: /motion Build a 20-second product launch video from this repo. Inspect the project first, create Style Lock and storyboard, then build the best local renderer path and preview it.
/motion-style Give me three genuinely different visual directions, each with Style DNA, one expressive move, engine affinity and anti-slop rules.
/motion-review Inspect the current motion project and render output. Find concrete visual/timing problems and patch the code, maximum three review cycles.
